69cbb050-b785-47ee-9787-d7e22a708f8b_lg..assessment: Dr. David L. Porter headshot (navy polo, warm beige backdrop, natural light). Only 275x385 px; the ProSites CDN has no larger original (tried no-suffix, _xl, _xlg, _orig, _original, _full, _md -> 404; only a smaller _sm exists). Usable as a small portrait only; a new high-res portrait is needed for any large use.
